name: paste-button
title: Paste button
description: Paste from the clipboard with one press: it asks permission, checks the text, and says what it pasted, why it refused, or how to allow access.
docs: The clipboard is read only when the button is pressed. Pass targetRef to fill and focus an input, and validate to refuse text with a reason. Where the browser blocks or lacks readText it focuses the field and says to press Ctrl V; pass read for a native shell.
